messages:
Seema: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: leaders, can we get a short, actionable timeline and "what-to-do-now" checklist for the three asks we heard: API streaming/function-call SLAs, console canary controls, and Optimize suggestions? trying to sync PMs and SEs today. :calendar:

Dmitri: TL;DR bullets: API streaming SLA beta in ~2w, GA in ~6w; console canary UI dogfood in ~3w then public beta; Optimize suggestions in staging this week, GA EOY-quarter. I'll post dates + minimal migration steps in this thread.

Rina: for the SLA, teams keep asking if they need to change client code for streaming or function-calls. short answer?

Dmitri: no protocol changes. Streaming/function-calls remain the same API surface. SLA is an account-level opt-in and measured server-side. Clients that rely on very low-latency tail behavior should run the provided p95 tests during dogfood.

Carlos: console canary controls 12: what knobs will be available and will they be editable via API?

Dmitri: initial knobs: canary_percent, canary_window_min, error_threshold_pct, auto_rollback_on_errors. UI-first; API endpoints follow in beta. example config snippet to be exposed:
```json
{"canary_percent":10,"canary_window_min":30,"auto_rollback_on_errors":true}
```

Rina: Optimize: will suggestions include quantization changes? if so, how do we validate accuracy impact?

Dmitri: yes, Optimize will surface batching + quantization suggestions. Each suggestion includes estimated token savings and a quality-risk score plus a small audit suite you can run (golden prompts) before applying. auto-apply off by default.

Seema: concrete dates I'm putting in the roadmap doc: API SLA beta 2026-04-08, GA 2026-05-20. Console dogfood 2026-04-22, public beta 2026-05-06. Optimize staging 2026-03-31, GA 2026-06-30.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: console canary dogfood on 2026-04-22. :white_check_mark:

Carlos: thanks. Can product leads get the one-page migration checklist? we need minimal acceptance tests for canary and optimize.

Dmitri: checklist (one-liner bullets): 1) Enable account SLA flag (if opted-in) 2) Create canary route + set canary_percent (10%) 3) Run load and quality checks for 30min window 4) Configure alert webhook for auto_rollback 5) For Optimize, run suggestions in staging and run golden prompts before apply. I'll pin a doc link here in 30m.

Seema: awesome. closing this thread; DM me to join the beta list.
